query:
UPDATE projects SET name = ?, name_norm = ?, client = ?, url = ?, repo_url = ?, runtimes = ?,
                                 environments = ?, brief = ?, watch_fixes = COALESCE(?, watch_fixes),
                                 log_min_level = COALESCE(?, log_min_level),
                                 log_retention_days = COALESCE(?, log_retention_days)
             WHERE id = ?
